description: Na₃CaSc₃Zn(SiO₃)₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.78 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.67 Å. Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.78 Å. There are three inequivalent Sc sites. In the first Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.33 Å. In the second Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.27 Å. In the third Sc site, Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.27 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent ScO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.42 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.71 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.70 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.70 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ScO₆ pentagonal pyramid, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ZnO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.70 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Zn, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Ca, one Sc, one Zn, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCaScZnSi trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Sc, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaSc₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Ca and two Si atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Sc, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaSc₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, one Zn, and one Si atom.
